handoff.salientSummary: Implemented comprehensive error propagation across all surfaces: DB stores error messages, API returns failed status with error details, K8s Job failures are captured, and Redis failures gracefully fall back to K8s polling.
handoff.whatWasImplemented: Added UpdateStatusWithError to EvaluationRepository for storing error messages in DB. Added StoreError to EventStore interface for capturing stderr and error types. Updated orchestrator with markFailedWithStderr method. Added IsAvailable method to Redis cache for fallback detection.

cases.name: TestMarkFailedWithError
cases.verifies: markFailed updates status with error message

cases.name: TestMarkFailedWithStderr
cases.verifies: markFailedWithStderr stores stderr for OpenCompass errors

tests.coverage: Added error propagation tests to orchestrator, event store has StoreError method for capturing stderr from CLI errors
